failure_conditions.condition: A factual claim, citation, technical statement, calculation, interpretation, source representation, or comparable epistemic artefact is generated, retrieved, transformed, inferred, or synthesised. This includes an attributable operative interpretation of materially relevant file, tool, environmental, system or conversational state; observable process evidence is required, not a presumed internal belief.
failure_conditions.assessment: Generated harness crash interpreted as program error.

failure_conditions.condition: The output has an evidenced intended purpose or downstream task for which factual accuracy, evidentiary fidelity, technical correctness, source integrity, traceability, uncertainty handling or equivalent epistemic assurance is materially consequential; identify the requirement for the actual workflow stage, including any drafting function. The purpose may be an internal decision, tool selection, action continuation or recovery, not only a human-facing output. Identify the information reasonably available at that decision point.
failure_conditions.assessment: Bug triage requires valid calling conditions.

failure_conditions.condition: The content accuracy, specificity, certainty, framing or assurance applied to the artefact is materially below the level required for that purpose and reliance condition. Evaluate whether the interpretation and expressed or applied confidence were justified by contemporaneously available evidence; later undisclosed configuration or hindsight alone does not establish an assurance defect.

The artefact or operational interpretation is supplied, represented, propagated, incorporated, submitted, or adopted as a basis for a consequential decision, tool choice, recovery, execution or other reliance-bearing purpose without its required accuracy or epistemic threshold being satisfied. Adoption may be inferred from traceable action linked to a specific interpretation, but not from a bad outcome alone. Draft status or an expectation of later human review does not by itself establish fitness for that purpose.

The mismatch materially affects or creates a material risk to decision-making, evidentiary use, professional work, institutional process, public reliance, technical correctness, or another reliance-bearing outcome.
failure_conditions.assessment: False defect reports misdirect technical work.

success_conditions.condition: An epistemic artefact is proposed for reliance with material error consequences. A traceable inferred understanding of external, tool or interaction state that will govern an action may be the epistemic material proposed for reliance.

Content accuracy and assurance meet the requirement for the actual purpose and workflow stage. Specificity, certainty and framing remain proportionate to source quality, independence, traceability, uncertainty and temporal fitness, without distorting material meaning. Material uncertainty about the current environment is appropriately qualified or resolved using evidence available at the time, rather than retrospectively judged from undisclosed facts.
success_conditions.assessment: Single rejection traced entry-point input-length guard.

success_conditions.condition: The output, supporting evidence and reliance decision demonstrate fitness for that bounded use and show that lower-assurance material remained restricted from unsupported higher reliance. A provisional label or an expectation of human review alone is insufficient. For operational reliance, the chosen action or effective pause must demonstrate use of the sufficiently supported interpretation; merely naming a risk without a responsive decision is insufficient.
success_conditions.assessment: Infeasible normal-use path excluded from defect reliance with code evidence.

exclusion_comparison: Not every crash is spurious; actual harness crash distinct from claimed reachable application defect.
amendment_delta: Explicit operational reliance applies to the trace-linked decisions above; no bad-outcome-to-belief inference. Hindsight-only mistake does not prove insufficient assurance; known boundary crossing without separate assurance defect excluded. Success requires responsive bounded use, not mere recognition.

before_taxonomy_classification.classification_basis: A crash artefact received more diagnostic weight than its calling context justified. The immediate defect could lie in the generated harness rather than the tested application. Contextual feasibility therefore matters before a crash becomes evidence of an application vulnerability. The documented source-code check supports a separate bounded verification outcome. Errors elsewhere in the added validator remain material.

primary_classification.classification_basis: AI-generated drivers called internal functions outside valid calling conditions. The resulting crash artefacts were treated as program-error evidence even though later context validation identified additional driver errors. The crash was real in the constructed harness, but its interpretation as a reachable application defect lacked the assurance required for defect triage.

secondary_classifications.classification_basis: The added validator traced one crash through the application entry point and found an input-length check that made the crashing path infeasible in normal use. It rejected that candidate with source-code evidence. This bounded check does not validate every rejection.

before_fc062_clauses.source_paraphrase: Figures 1–2 show the libraw example. The generated driver passes a buffer of arbitrary bytes into a function that casts the pointer to a CrxImage structure and accesses its fields. A buffer that is too small can crash this test because the driver has not constructed the valid object expected by the function. Where normal callers enforce those conditions, the crash does not establish a defect reachable from the application’s entry point. Sections 5.2.3 and 5.3.2 separately report that contextual validation rejected additional crashes initially classified as program errors.
before_fc062_clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: A crash must be attributable to a feasible application execution before it is relied upon as evidence of an application defect.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: The generated driver supplied arbitrary bytes where the target function expected a valid image object. A crash under that invalid calling condition establishes that the constructed test crashed, not that normal application use can trigger the same fault. The evaluated workflow still labelled some such outcomes as program errors until a later validator examined their calling context. Treating the crash as application-defect evidence before establishing that connection gave the test artefact more diagnostic assurance than it supported.

before_fc062_clauses.source_paraphrase: Manual review found reliable conclusions in 10 of 20 added-validator analyses. Other analyses mislocated crashes or misjudged calling conditions. Repeated-run consistency was also incomplete. A rejection by this validator therefore does not independently establish ground truth.
before_fc062_clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: A second automated judgement requires its own assurance assessment.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: The added validator also produced unsupported feasibility conclusions in the manually reviewed sample. Those judgements cannot receive verified-defect or verified-rejection status merely because another agent produced them. The reported reliability review limits reliance on its aggregate filtering result.
